summary_1line: Dasaratha laments helplessly as Kaikeyi insists on her boons—Rama’s exile and Bharata’s coronation—while Ayodhya unknowingly prepares for Rama’s coronation.

image_candidates.scene_text: King Dasaratha collapses to the floor in anguish while Kaikeyi stands unmoved beside him in the dim royal chamber.
Outside the palace, Ayodhya’s streets are decorated with flags, flowers, and incense as joyful citizens await Rama’s coronation.
Sage Vasishtha arrives at the palace gate carrying sacred vessels and ritual items for the coronation as crowds gather expectantly.
